description: Phase 09 Prompt 34 — source-linked retrieval proof. A read-only, advisory proof that EVERY retrieval result returned by the hybrid retrieval broker maps to an approved source ref: a result is source-linked iff it carries a non-empty source_ref and a source_family that is allowlisted (not in the EXCLUDED_FAMILIES raw-family set). The proof runs the hybrid broker (deterministic authoritative + advisory semantic, mock-embedded in the controlled proof) and counts result_count / linked_count / unlinked_count; proof_passed is true only when result_count > 0 and unlinked_count == 0. Metadata-only: persists a guard-clean summary row (read-only by default, on --emit-receipt) to the reserved V38 second_brain_retrieval_source_linked_proof_runs table (run_id / checked_count / source_linked_count / unlinked_count / status + 23 guard columns). No raw source content, query text, excerpts, prompts, responses, tokens, signed/download URLs, vectors, or arbitrary SQL is persisted or emitted (only counts, hashed run ids, source families, and a status). Makes no determination; read-only; fail-closed on missing policy or stale schema.
